Shuru aur ant

Shabd, saral bhasha mein

Kitaab mein sikhaaye gaye har shabd ka matlab, alphabet ke kram mein, us chapter ke saath jahan woh pehli baar samjhaya gaya. Kul 236 shabd.

ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVW

A

A/B test
do chai ke stall saath-saath: aap badlaav ko users ke ek random aadhe hisse ko dikhate hain aur baaki aadhe se compare karte hain; random baant se hi aap keh paate hain ki badlaav ne farq paida kiya Chapter 44
AARRR
growth ke paanch stages, har ek ko ek ginne layak event diya gaya: acquisition, activation, retention, referral aur revenue Chapter 43
abstention
us student jaisa jo andaaza lagane ki jagah "mujhe nahi pata" likhta hai: system jawaab na dene ka faisla karta hai, aur yeh kehta hai, jab uske paas evidence nahi hai; yeh product behaviour hai jise design karna padta hai, instruction ka ek sentence nahi Chapter 35
acceptance criteria
teacher ke number dene ke niyam: woh shartein jo kaam ko "ho gaya" maanne ke liye poori karni hoti hain, har ek aise likhi ki jaanchi ja sake Chapter 7
access control
har almari ke apne taale jaisa: rules jo tay karte hain ki kaun sa user kaun sa document ya chunk dekh sakta hai, jo application aur data layer mein lagte hain, model ke bharose nahi chhode jaate Chapter 35
activation moment
woh pehli baar jab user ko woh value milti hai jiska product waada karta hai; usse pehle ka sab kuch user ke liye cost hai Chapter 43
agentic search
ek helper jo khud kai searches chalata hai, jo wapas aaye use padhta hai, aur sawaal dobara likhta hai, ek loop mein Chapter 23
AI agent
errands ki list aur curfew wala madadgaar: ek model, woh functions jo woh maang sakta hai, ek loop, aur kab rukna hai uska rule Chapter 20
AI value chain
imaarat ki manzilein jinke upar AI product khada hai: infrastructure, models, tooling aur sabse upar woh apps jo log use karte hain; har manzil ka edge alag cheez se aata hai Chapter 31
allowlist
un cheezon ki list jo system ko karne ki ijaazat hai, aur jo list mein nahi hai woh mana hai Chapter 45
answer key
guard ke liye teacher ki answer key: har example sentence ke liye theek-theek yeh ki kya milna chahiye aur uske saath kya hona chahiye, jo numbered versions mein save hoti hai Chapter 12
API
counter ke aar-paar thamayi gayi order slip: ek program ka doosre program se tay format mein kuch maangne ka tareeka Chapter 9
API key
model ka secret password, jo company ko yeh bhi batata hai ki bill kise bhejna hai: ek lamba code jo batata hai ki kaun maang raha hai; jiske paas yeh hai woh aapka paisa kharch kar sakta hai Chapter 9
architecture decision record
ek bade technical choice par chhota note: baaki options, chuna hua option, saboot, nateeje, aur kya hone par aap use dobara dekhenge Chapter 40
attack surface
ghar ke saare darwaaze aur khidkiyan: woh har jagah jahan koi bahar wala kuch andar daal sakta hai ya system ka kaam chhu sakta hai; har tool, input aur connection ek aur jagah badhata hai Chapter 39
attention
sentence mein peeche mud kar dekhna: transformer ka woh hissa jo tay karta hai ki agla kya aayega, yeh guess karne ke liye baaki kaun se tokens sabse zyada maayne rakhte hain Chapter 8
audit trail
gate ka visitors register, kaam se alag rakha hua: kisne kya kiya, kab, kis rule se, kya result raha, taaki incident dobara jod kar samjha ja sake Chapter 39

B

B2B
woh dukaan jo doosri dukaanon ko bechti hai. Business to business: aisa product jo companies ko becha jaata hai, jahan paisa dene wala aksar wahi nahi hota jo use chalata hai Chapter 2
B2C
woh dukaan jo ek-ek grahak ko bechti hai. Business to consumer: aisa product jo ek-ek insaan ko becha jaata hai, jo khareedta bhi hai aur istemaal bhi karta hai Chapter 2
bottom-up estimate
jaise apni gali ki dukaanein gino aur jodo ki har ek kitna dengi, kisi badi report ka tukda lene ke bajaye; aise customers se banaya gaya size jinhe aap gin sakte hain Chapter 4
bounded agent
errands ki list aur curfew wale helper jaisa: aisa AI agent jiske steps, time aur cost par hard limits hain, ek state jo woh saaf dikhata rakhta hai, aur ek "cannot resolve" ending, taaki woh hamesha ruke Chapter 36

C

caching
dukaan jaisi jo aapka roz ka order taiyaar rakhti hai. Provider request ka woh shuruaati hissa yaad rakhta hai jo woh padh chuka hai. Agli baar shuru wahi ho toh request sasti aur tez hoti hai Chapter 21
canary release
trial run: badlaav pehle kuch hi users ko dikhana, purana version taiyaar rakhkar, sabko dene se pehle Chapter 38
cascade
clinic jaisa jahan pehle nurse sabko dekhti hai aur specialist sirf mushkil cases dekhta hai; har request sabse sasti cheez ke paas jaati hai jo kaam kar sake, aur sirf jo check mein fail ho woh agle, mehnge step par jaati hai Chapter 26
case study
ek project ka ek ya do page ka bayaan: problem aur uska saboot, aapke decisions aur woh options jo aapne reject kiye, trade-offs, numbers ke saath results, jo fail hua, aur aap aage kya karte Chapter 47
changelog
har release mein kya badla, iski chhoti public list, jo users ke liye practical shabdon mein likhi gayi ho Chapter 46
chunk
lambi kitaab se kaate gaye ek index card jaisa; document ka ek tukda, itna chhota ki akele store aur send ho sake Chapter 14
chunking
lambi kitaab ko index cards mein kaatne jaisa; aap tay karte hain ki har cut kahan lagega Chapter 14
claim audit
AI ke likhe summary se das claims uthana aur har ek ko uske source se check karna, har ek ko supported, partly supported ya unsupported mark karte hue Chapter 45
classifier
fixed dabbon wala sorter, jaise post office pin code se chitthiyan chhaanta hai: ek program jo har input ko pehle se tay categories mein se ek mein daalta hai, jaise PAN, Aadhaar, mobile number ya inmein se koi nahi Chapter 13
code check
ek cheez ka paimana (ruler): aam code ki kuch lines jo jawaab ke ek fact ko test karti hain, jaise kya quote kiya phrase sach mein message mein hai; har badlaav par chalana free hai Chapter 25
cohort
school ka ek batch: woh users jinhone ek hi period mein shuru kiya, aur jinhe saath-saath time ke saath follow kiya jaata hai Chapter 44
compaction
lambi chat ko chhota karna. Beech ka hissa summarise karte hain, shuru aur aakhir rakhte hain Chapter 21
competitor teardown
jaise do phone mez par saath-saath rakhna: har rival ke liye, woh kiske liye hai, kitne ka hai, kahan achha hai, aur customers kis baat ki shikayat karte hain Chapter 4
context engineering
model ki mez ko sambhal kar bharna. Aap tay karte hain ki har request mein kya jaayega, kis order mein, aur kya bahar rahega: instructions, examples, saboot, chat history aur tool ke results Chapter 21
context judge
samajhdaar badi-buzurg jo mushkil sentences padhte hain: yeh woh chhote sentences padhta hai jinhe pehle do hisse tay nahi kar paaye, aur decide karta hai ki woh kisi insaan ki taraf ishaara karte hain ya nahi Chapter 7
context window
model ki mez: ek baar mein kitna text us par aa sakta hai, uski limit, jismein aap jo bhejte hain aur jo woh wapas likhta hai, dono gine jaate hain Chapter 8
contextual retrieval
har index card par ek note ki yeh kis kitaab ke kis chapter se aaya hai, taaki akela mila card bhi samajh aaye Chapter 23
contribution margin
customer ke diye har rupaye mein se, customer ke saath badhne wale costs ke baad, jo bachta hai. Samajhiye khane ki plate, saamaan ka paisa dene ke baad Chapter 42
conversation history
chat ke pichhle messages, ledger ke pannon jaise; model ko sab yaad lage, iske liye app ko inhe har naye message ke saath dobara bhejna padta hai Chapter 10
cost of delay
jaise shelf par rakha doodh phat jaata hai; har us hafte ka nuksaan jab tak koi option intezaar karta hai Chapter 5

D

dark pattern
aisa design jo users ko apne hi khilaaf kaam karne par dhokhe se majboor kare, jaise pehle se tick kiya box, jhoothi kami ya chhupa hua cancellation Chapter 43
data contract
system ke do hisson ke beech data ke baare mein chupa hua vaada, jaise "form mein hamesha naam ka box hoga"; jaise ek field maujood hogi aur list khaali nahi hogi Chapter 33
data residency
us godown ke pate jaisa jahan aapka maal rakha hai; woh desh ya region jahan provider aapka bheja hua store aur handle karta hai Chapter 28
decision log
bade faislon ki diary. Ek page jismein aap har bada decision, uska saboot, aur woh baat likhte hain jisse aap apna mind badal denge Chapter 1
decision memo
jaise akhbaar ki khabar jiska pehla paragraph sab bata deta hai; ek chhota note jise vyast insaan uski shuruaat padh kar act kar sake Chapter 6
deletion drill
data ki fire drill: maan lijiye ek customer ne apna data delete karne ko kaha, phir woh har jagah dhoondhiye jahan data rehta hai, aur dekhiye kin jagahon tak aap pahunch nahi sakte Chapter 29
delivery
rasoi mein dish ko achhe se pakana. Product banane ka woh hissa jahan aap use theek se banate hain: plan, likhi hui details, code aur checking Chapter 2
dependency
jaise deewar rangne se pehle plumber ka intezaar; koi bhi cheez jo aapko khatam karne ke liye apni team ke bahar se chahiye Chapter 6
design partner
ek early user jo ek adhoore product ko use karne aur aapko imaandaari se bataane par raazi ho ki use kya mila, kisi seedhi, fair cheez ke badle mein Chapter 46
diagnosis
jaise dawai se pehle doctor ki jaanch; strategy ka pehla hissa, asli problem kya hai iska imaandaar hisaab Chapter 5
discovery
dukaan kholne se pehle dekhna ki mohalle ko kya chahiye. Product banane ka woh hissa jahan aap pata lagate hain ki problem asli hai aur hal karne layak hai Chapter 2
distribution
dish ko counter par rakhna jahan log dekh sakein. Product banane ka woh hissa jahan log use dhoondhte hain, try karte hain aur istemaal karte rehte hain Chapter 2
document audit
godown ka maal ginne jaisa, shelves banane se pehle; aap random sample lekar ginte hain ki kitna saaf digital text hai, kitna scanned hai, aur kitne mein matlab tables aur layout mein chhupa hai Chapter 27
DPDP Act
India ka Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, jo batata hai ki logon ki diary (personal data) ke saath kaise pesh aana hai; yeh data dhoondhne aur chhupane se kahin zyada maangta hai Chapter 29

E

edge case
daak-ghar mein aaya ajeeb parcel: ek anokha input jo woh cheezein tod deta hai jinhe aam cases kabhi chhoote nahi Chapter 7
embedding
matlab ka pata; numbers ki ek lambi list jo text ko map par rakhti hai, taaki ek matlab wale texts ek hi gali mein rahein, chaahe ek bhi word common na ho Chapter 16
environment variable
code ke bahar, taale wali daraaz mein rakha secret, us jagah jahan program chalta hai; passwords aur API keys wahin rehti hain Chapter 33
error analysis
galat jawaabon ko ek-ek karke padhna aur unhe dher mein baantna, jaise complaints chhaantna; aap 100 asli outputs padhte hain, apne words mein likhte hain ki kya galat hua, notes ko group karte hain, groups ko naam dete hain aur ginte hain Chapter 25
event taxonomy
har us event ki naam likhi shelf jo product record karta hai, ek naming rule ke saath jise sab maanein, jaise object_action, lower case mein aur past tense mein Chapter 44
evidence pack
rasidon ke dabbe jaisa. Isme woh sab hota hai jisse koi aur aapke claims check kar sake, sirf bharosa na kare Chapter 41
exit cost
ek provider ko chhodkar doosre par jaane ki keemat, paise, time aur risk mein, jaise bank badalne ki mehnat; ek vendor quality mein jeet kar bhi aapko saalon tak baandh sakta hai Chapter 40
experiment runner
ek dobara use hone wala program jo har experiment likh leta hai, lab notebook jaisa: inputs, outputs, settings, timings aur errors; isse aap result dohra kar aur compare kar sakte hain Chapter 33

F

failure class
kharabi ki ek kisam, kisi ek kharabi ka instance nahi. Tab das tests ka matlab banta hai, das kahaniyon ka nahi Chapter 41
failure threshold
pass marks jo trial shuru hone se pehle likh lete hain; result usse neeche aaye toh trial ko failure kehte hain Chapter 32
feasibility
kya rasoi sach mein woh dish bana sakti hai. Kya team ke paas jo time, skills, data aur paisa hai, usse use bana sakti hai Chapter 2
feature flag
chalte hue system mein ek switch jo ek badlaav ko kuch users ke liye on aur baaki ke liye off karta hai, bina nayi release ke Chapter 45
findings document
mechanic ke repair log jaisa. Isme saaf likha hota hai kya toota, saboot, root cause, fix, aur jaan-boojhkar kya unsolved chhoda gaya. Yeh brochure ka ulta hai Chapter 41
fine-tuning
model ko apne bahut se examples par coach karna, jab tak woh ek aadat pakad le; yeh behaviour sikhati hai, facts nahi Chapter 31
five whys
pyaaz ki parat chheelna: baar-baar "kyun?" poochhna. Har jawaab par poochhte hain, taaki symptom se uski wajahon tak pahunchein Chapter 3
fixed workflow
kram se likhi recipe jaisa: steps pehle se tay hote hain aur code mein likhe hote hain, aur model sirf un steps mein use hota hai jinhe judgement chahiye Chapter 36
flywheel
ek bhaari pahiye jaisa jo ek baar dhakka dene par ghoomta rehta hai. Product use karne se behtar hota hai, aur isse aur use aata hai. Workflow wala kisam aksar sabse mazboot hota hai Chapter 42
Fogg behaviour model
yeh idea ki koi behaviour tab hota hai jab motivation, ability aur prompt ek hi pal mein milte hain; agar nahi ho raha, toh in teeno ko ulte order mein check kijiye Chapter 43

G

generative AI
aisa AI jo nayi cheezein banata hai, jaise text, images ya code, sirf ek label ya number nahi deta Chapter 8
Git
ek tool jo aapke kaam ka har version save karta hai, badlaavon ki photo album jaisa, taaki aap kisi bhi purane version par wapas ja sakein Chapter 33
golden dataset
poore product ki answer key: bahut saare asli cases, har ek ke saath expected result, aur ek version number taaki aap use dobara chala sakein Chapter 38
graceful degradation
jab ek hissa tootta hai, system chhote lekin safe tareeke se chalta rehta hai, jaise card machine kharab ho toh dukaan sirf cash leti hai Chapter 40
gross margin
dukaandaar ke munafe jaisa, maal ka paisa dene ke baad. Yeh kamayi minus product deliver karne ka seedha cost hai. AI products mein is cost ka bada hissa aksar model ya hosting ka bill hota hai Chapter 42
grounded answer
saboot ke saath aaya jawaab, jaise woh student jo bata deta hai ki kaun se page se likha. Yeh system ke diye saboot se aata hai, us se nahi jo model ko apne aap yaad ho Chapter 18
growth loop
ek cycle jisme ek user ke actions agle user ko laate hain, taaki output wapas input ban jaye Chapter 43
guardrail metric
jaise pul ki railing; aisa number jo key results ke peeche bhaagte hue kharab nahi hona chahiye Chapter 6
guiding policy
jaise ghar ke niyam jo tay karte hain ki kya karenge aur kya nahi; strategy ka doosra hissa, aapka poora tareeka, jismein woh bhi hai jo aap mana karte hain Chapter 5

H

hallucination
pakke yakeen se boli gayi banawati baat: ek banaya hua jawaab jo seedhe chehre se diya jaata hai; aisa isliye hota hai ki model likely shabd gadhta hai, aur "mujhe nahi pata" aksar sabse likely nahi hota Chapter 11
harness
model ke aas-paas ki woh sab cheezein jo use product banati hain: woh code jo uska context banata hai, uske tools chalata hai, state rakhta hai, rules lagata hai, quality check karta hai aur record karta hai ki kya hua Chapter 45
HTTP
request bhejne aur reply paane ke rules, jaise chitthi post karne ke rules; har reply par ek number hota hai jo batata hai ki kaam hua ya nahi Chapter 33
human oversight
ek insaan jo output ke peeche ka saboot dekh sakta hai aur use na keh sakta hai; outputs ko bas guzarte dekhna isme nahi ginta Chapter 29
hybrid pricing
data wale phone plan jaisa. Ek tay fee mein kuch use shamil hota hai, aur uske upar ka alag dena padta hai. Buyer plan kar sakta hai, aur aapka margin surakshit rehta hai Chapter 42
hybrid search
Ctrl+F jaisi word search aur matlab wali search ko saath chalana, phir dono lists ko milana, taaki ek chunna na pade Chapter 23

I

idempotency
lift ka button do baar dabane jaisa: aisa action jo do baar chalana safe hai, ya aise protect kiya gaya hai ki do baar chalne ka sirf ek hi asar ho; yeh tay karta hai ki retry safe hai ya nahi Chapter 36
incident review
kuch galat hone ke baad likha gaya ek chhota writeup ki kya hua, kyun hua, aur kaun sa check use pakad leta Chapter 45
inference
taiyaar model se ek sawaal poochhna: use kisi request ka jawaab dene ke liye chalana; har baar paisa lagta hai aur model badalta nahi Chapter 8
informed consent
kisi insaan ki haan, jo use saaf-saaf bataane ke baad di gayi ho ki kya collect hota hai, kahan jaata hai, kya galat ho sakta hai aur wapas kaise liya jaye Chapter 46
ingestion
us clerk jaisa jo kagaz scan karke office computer mein daalta hai: documents ko system mein padhne ka step, jisme scan karna, parse karna aur tukdon mein todna shamil hai; yahan jo kho gaya, woh hamesha ke liye kho gaya Chapter 35
input metric
jaise wazan ghatane ke liye roz ke kadam ginna; aisa number jise team seedha badal sakti hai, aur jisse aap result hilne ki ummeed karte hain Chapter 6
instruction tuning
hal kiye hue examples se coaching: doosra stage, jismein model instructions aur achhe jawaabon ke jodon se seekhta hai, taaki woh instructions maane Chapter 8

J

job to be done
rickshaw is liye kiraaye par lena ki pahunchna hai, savari ke liye nahi. Woh progress jo ek insaan apni zindagi mein karna chahta hai, aur jiske liye woh kisi product ko "kaam par rakhta" hai Chapter 3
JSON
curly brackets ke andar labels aur values mein likha ek form; lagbhag har API use karti hai Chapter 9

K

key result
jaise woh marks jo dikhate hain ki aap paas hue; goal ke neeche ke teen-chaar numbers mein se ek. Woh naapta hai ki logon ke liye kya badla, yeh nahi ki aapne kya ship kiya Chapter 6
keyword search
Ctrl+F dabane jaisa; woh sawaal ke exact words ko documents ke words se milakar text dhoondhti hai, isliye spelling compare karti hai, matlab nahi Chapter 15
kill criterion
jaise trek ka niyam, "agar dopahar tak pul tak nahi pahunche toh wapas mudo"; pehle se likhi hui shart jiske poora hone par kaam rok diya jaata hai Chapter 6
kill switch
board ka main switch: ek flag traffic ko turant ek saade, bina-AI wale raaste par bhej deta hai, nayi deployment ke bina; yeh tabhi chalta hai jab woh raasta maujood ho aur haal mein test hua ho Chapter 30

L

language model
ek tota jisne poori library padh li ho: ek program jisne bahut saare likhe text se seekha hai ki aage kaun sa text aayega, iska andaaza lagana; chatbot ke peeche yahi hota hai Chapter 8
latency
intezaar ka time, jaise chai order karke chai ka intezaar; poochhne aur jawaab milne ke beech ka gap, jise user speed ki tarah mehsoos karta hai Chapter 22
latency budget
ek request ke liye kul intezaar ka time, jo uske stages mein baanta hota hai, jaise safar train, bus aur paidal mein baanta jaata hai, taaki sabse dheema stage mile aur uska koi owner ho Chapter 40
leaderboard
school ki rank list jaisa, par models ke liye; woh kisi aur ke tests par scores dikhata hai, aapke nahi Chapter 34
leading question
"yeh bilkul taaza hai, hai na?" jaisa sawaal. Woh aisa sawaal hai jo poochhne wale ke man ka jawaab hi saamne wale ke munh mein daal deta hai Chapter 3
least privilege
mehmaan ko sirf us ek kamre ki chaabi dena jo use chahiye, taaki dhokha khane par bhi nuksaan chhota rahe Chapter 39
lethal trifecta
teen cheezein jo saath milkar system ko khatarnaak banati hain: woh private data dekh sakta hai, woh aisa text padhta hai jo bahar ke log likh sakte hain, aur uske paas kuch bahar bhejne ka raasta hai Chapter 24
LLM judge
homework ko marks dene wala doosra student; ek model jo doosri model ke jawaab grade karti hai, sasti aur tez, par uske biases hote hain, isliye bharosa karne se pehle marker ko teacher se check kijiye Chapter 25
lock-in
ek provider se bandh jaana kyunki chhodna bahut mehnga hai, rewriting, dobara naapne ya khoye hue features ki wajah se Chapter 31

M

mask
kisi detail ka ek hissa chhupana par uski shape rakhna, jaise 98******12 Chapter 7
MCP
Model Context Protocol: plug aur socket jaisa, AI applications ko tools aur data se jodne ka ek standard, jisse standard par bana koi bhi tool standard par bani kisi bhi application mein lag jaata hai Chapter 36
metadata filtering
har file par label, jaise version, dates aur kaun dekh sakta hai; scoring se pehle jo files sahi ho hi nahi sakti unhe nikaal dena Chapter 23
minimum detectable effect
sabse chhota badlaav jise pakadna kaam ka hai; yeh tay karta hai ki test ko kitne users chahiye Chapter 44
model selection card
faisle ka ek page ka file card: kaam, quality target, data, speed aur cost ki limits, try kiye options, evidence aur fallback; isse reviewer dekh leta hai ki aapne woh model kyun chuna Chapter 34
MoSCoW
jaise safar ke liye bag pack karna, cheezon ko Must, Should, Could aur Won't (nahi lenge) mein baantna Chapter 5
multimodal
padhne, dekhne aur sunne wale insaan jaisa: sirf text nahi, pages, tasveerein, tables aur speech bhi lene ke kaabil; isse badal jaata hai ki evidence kise kehte hain aur use wapas kaise trace karte hain Chapter 37
must-keep list
woh facts jo padhne wale ko khone nahi chahiye, har document ke liye likhe hue; har summary ko is par tick kiya jaata hai, shopping list ki tarah Chapter 13
MVP
minimum viable product, yaani sabse chhoti cheez jo asli users ke saath aapke sabse risky andaaze ko aazmaye Chapter 7

N

name-and-place finder
woh guard jo list mein naam padhta hai: yeh un details ko dhoondhta hai jinki koi fixed shape nahi, jaise kisi insaan ka naam, pata ya employer Chapter 7
network effect
product ka sabke liye behtar hona jaise-jaise zyada log use karein, jo is se alag hai ki users doosre users ko laayein Chapter 43
North Star
jaise woh taara jiske sahare naav chalane wale chalte hain; ek sentence jo batata hai ki customers ko kya milta hai, aur ek number jo use naapta hai Chapter 5

O

observability
saved records se dekh paana ki system ne kya kiya aur kyun, bina andaaza lagaye Chapter 38
observation session
ek meeting jisme aap kisi ko ek asli kaam dete hain aur bina madad kiye use karte dekhte hain, har baar wahi cheezein note karte hue Chapter 46
OCR
us clerk jaisa jo photo dekh kar bol-bol kar type karta hai; optical character recognition woh software hai jo text ki picture ko text mein badalta hai, aam taur par kuch galtiyon ke saath Chapter 27
OKR
jaise report card ka goal aur uske saath marks: objectives and key results, shabdon mein likha goal aur kuch numbers jo dikhate hain ki aap wahan pahunche Chapter 6
open-weight model
sabke liye chhapi hui recipe: aap model (uske weights) download karke apne computers par chala sakte hain, kisi aur ke model ko call karne ke bajaye Chapter 31
opportunity tree
jaise ideas ka khaandaan-ka-ped: yeh us result se shuru hota hai jo aap chahte hain, logon ki batayi zaroorton ki branches banata hai, aur possible fix par khatam hota hai Chapter 4
orphaned chunk
chitthi se phate ek page jaisa; woh pichhle tukde ki kisi cheez ki taraf ishaara karta hai, isliye akela uska matlab nahi nikalta Chapter 14
outcome pricing
sirf pakdi hui machhli ka paisa dene jaisa. Har achhe result ka charge, taaki price value ke saath chale. Dono taraf ko number mein tay karna padta hai ki achha result kya hai Chapter 42

P

p95
woh time jise 100 mein se 95 requests beat kar deti hain; yeh dheemi chand requests dikhata hai jo average chhupa leta hai Chapter 38
parser
photocopier jaisa program jo kisi file, jaise PDF, ko saade text aur structure mein badalta hai; uski galtiyan uske baad ki har cheez ko dikhti hi nahi Chapter 35
pattern checker
gate par khada guard jo ticket ko uski shakal se parakhta hai: yeh un details ko dhoondhta hai jo hamesha ek hi shape ki hoti hain, jaise PAN ya mobile number, fixed rules se Chapter 7
persona
ek tarah ke user ka passport page. Us user ka chhota sa description, jo sirf interviews mein jo dikha usi se banaya gaya ho Chapter 3
PII
kisi ki diary ka ek panna. Koi bhi aisi detail jo ek asli insaan ki taraf ishaara kar sake, jaise naam, phone number ya pehchaan ka number Chapter 1
pilot
ek chhota trial, jaise poori shaadi ka khana banane se pehle ek trial batch; woh dikhata hai ki feature se business ko madad milti hai ya nahi, aur pehle hi bata deta hai ki kaun sa result failure hoga Chapter 32
pinned version
model ka woh version jo uske poore naam se fix kiya gaya hai, taaki provider use bina bataye badal na sake Chapter 30
positioning statement
jaise dukaan ke board par ek line jo batati hai ki dukaan kiske liye hai aur alag kyun hai; aapke product ke baare mein ek sentence Chapter 4
PRD
product requirements document, yaani kisi dish ka recipe card: yeh batata hai ki kya banana hai aur kyun, problem aur uske saboot se shuru karke Chapter 7
pre-mortem
jaise pakane se pehle dimaag mein dish chakh kar dekhna ki jal gayi hai; ek meeting jismein sab maan lete hain ki project fail ho gaya aur likhte hain ki kyun Chapter 6
pre-training
bahut badi library mein school ke saal: model banane ka pehla aur sabse mehnga stage, jismein woh bahut saare text par agla token guess karna seekhta hai Chapter 8
precision
jaal mein asli machhli gin kar dekhne jaisa; tool ne jo flag kiya, usmein se kitna sach mein wahi tha jo tool ne kaha. Agar 100 flag kiye aur 80 asli the, toh precision 80 percent hai Chapter 17
predictive AI
aisa AI jo ek kaam ke liye ek label ya ek number deta hai, jaise koi message spam hai ya nahi Chapter 8
problem statement
ek chhota note jo batata hai ki kise dikkat hai, kya hai, aur aaj usse kitna kharch hota hai. Yeh ek ya do sentence ka hota hai Chapter 3
product risk
chaar pairon wali mez ka ek pair. Ek pair tootaa toh mez gir jaati hai. Yeh un chaar cheezon mein se ek hai jo product ko doba sakti hain: koi use chahta nahi, koi use chala nahi sakta, use banaya nahi ja sakta, ya woh apna kharcha nahi nikaal sakta Chapter 2
product sense
ek user chunne, uski asli problem dhoondhne aur ek samajhdaar solution sujhane ki kabiliyat, jise interviewers aise sawaalon se parakhte hain jaise "ek state helpline ke liye voice assistant design kijiye" Chapter 47
product-led growth
customers aise jeetna ki users khud sign up karein aur khud value paayein, aur unmein se kuch upgrade karein; yeh tab fit hota hai jab value minutes mein dikhe aur price kam ho Chapter 43
production delta
prototype aur asli service ke beech ki kharidari ki list: identity, retries, queues, monitoring, secrets, backups aur rollback Chapter 40
project memory
code ke saath rakhi ek saadhi file, jisme project ke rules aur aadatein hoti hain, aur jo coding assistant ke har run ke shuru mein load hoti hai Chapter 45
prompt
woh parchi jo aap model ko thamate hain: aap kya chahte hain, aur kaise; usmein instructions, examples aur kaam ka material ho sakta hai Chapter 11
prompt injection
ek padhne wale khat ke andar chhupi parchi jo kehti hai "teacher ki baat mat suno"; model ko sirf padhne ke liye diye gaye material ke andar likha text use hukm deta hai, aur model maan sakta hai kyunki woh aapke hukm ko padhne ke liye diye gaye words se pakke taur par alag nahi kar sakta Chapter 24
prototype
gatte ka bana khilauna ghar: ek mota, sasta version jo asli ke bante se pehle kuch seekhne ke liye banaya jaata hai Chapter 7
provenance
woh kaagazi nishaan jo batata hai ki koi cheez kahan se aayi, taaki aap ek claim ya decision ko uske source, version aur banane wale code tak trace kar sakein Chapter 34
Python
woh programming language jisme zyadatar AI ka kaam likha jaata hai; ek product manager ke liye, yeh theek-theek kehne ka tareeka ki ek experiment kya karta hai Chapter 9

Q

quasi-identifier
aisa ishaara jo akela nirdosh hai par doosron ke saath milkar ek insaan ko pehchaan sakta hai, jaise umar, gaon aur ek rare bimari Chapter 7

R

reasoning model
ek aise student jaisa jo final jawaab likhne se pehle kachche kaagaz par hisaab lagata hai; model ek tareeka try karta hai, use check karta hai, phir reply deta hai, aur us kachche kaam ke paise aap har request par dete hain, paise mein bhi aur intezaar mein bhi Chapter 22
recall
jaal mein machhliyon jaisa; jitni asli cheezein dhoondhni thi, unmein se tool ne kitni dhoondhi. Agar 100 thi aur 90 mili, toh recall 90 percent hai Chapter 17
red team
dost chor: woh log jinka kaam jaan-boojhkar system par hamla karna hai, taaki kamzori koi aur dhoondhe, usse pehle woh dhoondh lein Chapter 39
redact
kisi detail ko poori tarah hata dena, jaise use [PAN] shabd se badal kar Chapter 7
refusal
tool ka sabhya "na", jaise dukaandaar kahe "yahan nahi milta, us counter par jaiye"; woh saaf kehta hai ki yeh kaam nahi kar sakta aur kisi insaan tak ka raasta batata hai; ise jaanboojh kar design karte hain Chapter 32
regression
aisa badlaav jo product ko us kaam mein kharab kar de jo woh pehle achhe se karta tha Chapter 38
release gate
launch se pehle ka taala-band darwaaza: ek automatic check badlaav par golden dataset chalata hai, aur koi bhi number threshold se neeche aaye toh use rok deta hai Chapter 38
repository
ek almaari jo aapke notes ki har purani copy sambhalti hai. GitHub jaisi site par ek online folder, jismein project ka kaam aur uska har purana version rehta hai Chapter 1
reranking
pehle ek tez helper pages ka bada dher laata hai, phir ek dheemi, dhyaan se padhne wali model sawaal aur har page saath mein padhkar sabse achhe kuch ko upar rakhti hai Chapter 23
residual risk
saare taale lagne ke baad jo risk bacha rehta hai; use likh dijiye, yeh mat maniye ki woh khatam ho gaya Chapter 39
retention
us dukaandaar jaisa jo aapke jaane ke baad ek mahine tak bill ki copy rakhta hai; provider aapka bheja hua kitni der rakhta hai, jo aksar jawaab dene ke time se bahut zyada hota hai Chapter 28
retrieval
dhoondhne ka step, jaise file mein se sahi page nikaalna. System aapke documents mein woh tukde dekhta hai jo sawaal se milte hain Chapter 18
retrieval-augmented generation
RAG: model ke liye open-book exam. Pehle system sawaal ke liye sahi pages dhoondhta hai. Phir woh pages sawaal ke saath model ko thama deta hai, aur model unhi se jawaab likhta hai Chapter 18
RICE
jaise exam ke marks: har option ka ek score, Reach guna Impact guna Confidence, bhaag Effort Chapter 5
risk register
ek table jisme har risk ke saath uska owner, uska control, control ke kaam karne ka saboot, aur bacha hua risk likha hota hai Chapter 39
risk tier
system ki speed limit jaisa: galat jawaab jitna zyada nuksaan kar sakta hai, system ko utne zyada documents, checks aur saboot chahiye; tier istemaal se tay hota hai, technology se nahi Chapter 29
riskiest assumption
pul ka sabse kamzor takhta. Woh baat jo sach honi hi chahiye taaki aapka idea chale, aur jis par aapko sabse kam yakeen hai, isliye jise sabse pehle test karna hai Chapter 3
roadmap
jaise parivaar ka hafte ka plan: aaj raat ka khaana pakka, agle hafte ki kharidari mumkin, kabhi ki chhutti ek khwaab; woh dikhata hai ki team kis par kaam karegi aur lagbhag kab, teen column mein, Now, Next aur Later, dates ki jagah results ka waada karke Chapter 6
role matrix
ek table jisme ek taraf woh skills hain jo asli job advertisements maangte hain aur upar roles hain, aur jisme aap har skill ko apne liye proven, partly proven ya missing mark karte hain Chapter 47
rollback
code ke purane version par wapas jaana, jaise pichle saal ki recipe par lautna; iske liye nayi deployment chahiye, aur jab dono versions mein wahi bura behaviour ho toh yeh madad nahi karta Chapter 30
rollback trigger
ek naapne layak condition, pehle se likhi hui, jo kisi ko release undo karne par bound karti hai Chapter 45
routing
ek front desk jo aasaan requests sasti madadgaar ko bhejta hai aur sirf mushkil wali mehngi expert ko; har request us sabse sasti model ke paas jaati hai jo use sambhal sake Chapter 34
rule-keeper
rule-book wala clerk: yeh tay karta hai ki mili hui har detail ke saath kya karna hai, jaise hata do, mask karo, jaane do ya poochho Chapter 7

S

SAM
serviceable addressable market: jaise shehar ke apne hisse ki woh dukaanein jin tak aap sach mein pahunch sakte hain; TAM ka woh hissa jise aap sambhal sakte hain Chapter 4
schema
khaali form khud: usme har khaana likha hota hai, us mein kya jaayega, aur kaun se khaane bharna zaroori hain. Model likhte waqt model chalane wali company ise lagu karti hai Chapter 19
scoreboard
woh table jo tool ke har version ke liye ginta hai ki usne kya dhoondha, kya chhod diya, aur kya galti se flag kar diya Chapter 12
SDK
software development kit: doosre builder ko dene wale toolbox jaisa. Ek chhoti library (ready-made code) aur ek demo, jise doosra developer apne product mein jod sakta hai, bina feature khud banaye Chapter 41
seat pricing
cinema ke har ticket jaisa. Har user ke liye, har mahine, charge karte hain. Buyer ke liye plan karna aasaan hai. Lekin tab unfair hai jab heavy users ko serve karna light users se kahin zyada mehnga ho Chapter 42
shadow AI
staff ka chupke se free consumer AI tools chalana, aksar office ke documents paste karke, kyunki woh tools kaam ke hain aur koi approved tool utna achha nahi Chapter 29
similarity score
paas hone ka marks card; lagbhag 0 se 1 ka number jo batata hai ki do embeddings kitni paas hain, aur jab tak aapko na pata ho ki achhe aur bure matches kitna score karte hain, iska matlab kam hai Chapter 16
SOM
serviceable obtainable market: jaise woh dukaanein jo aap lagbhag teen saal mein sach mein jeet sakte hain; SAM ka woh hissa jo aapko sach mein mil sakta hai Chapter 4
speaker attribution
natak ki script mein har line ke bagal mein naam likhne jaisa: recording mein yeh pata lagana ki kisne kaun se words kahe; yeh technical lagta hai, lekin privacy decision ki tarah behave karta hai Chapter 37
speech-to-text
bolne wale ko type karte clerk jaisa: woh software jo record ki hui speech ko likhe hue words mein badalta hai; yeh kisi bhi voice system ka pehla stage hai aur pehli jagah jahan matlab kho sakta hai Chapter 37
sprint
ek ya do hafte ka tay daur, jismein team plan karti hai, banati hai, dikhati hai aur review karti hai Chapter 7
staging
live system ki practice copy, jahan har badlaav pehle try hota hai, taaki kharab badlaav asli users tak na pahunche Chapter 40
stakeholder
jaise shaadi mein woh log jo shaadi chalwa ya rok sakte hain, jaise halwai aur hall ka malik; koi bhi jo project ki madad ya rok kar sakta hai, ya jis par uska asar padta hai Chapter 6
STAR method
apne beete hue kal ki kahani chaar hisson mein sunane ka tareeka: situation, task, action aur result, jisme zyadatar time is par jaata hai ki aapne kya kiya Chapter 47
state machine
ek workflow jisme aapka code har step aur ek step se doosre step tak har allowed move tay karta hai Chapter 45
stateless
goldfish jaisa bhulakkad: requests ke beech kuch nahi rakhta, isliye har call zero se shuru hoti hai, aur model ko nahi pata ki aapne abhi ek pal pehle usse baat ki thi Chapter 10
status code
HTTP reply par likha number, report card ke marks jaisa: 200 matlab kaam hua, 4xx matlab aapki request galat thi, 5xx matlab doosri taraf fail hua Chapter 33
status quo
jaise ghar ki purani aadat jo sab nibhate hain kyunki thodi-bahut kaam karti hai; log aaj jo karte hain, kuch na karna bhi. Aksar yahi sabse mazboot rival hota hai Chapter 4
step limit
curfew. Zyada se zyada kitne rounds ek AI agent rukne se pehle le sakta hai. Program use tay karta hai, model kabhi nahi Chapter 20
streaming
chai-wala jaise kaam karte hue "do minute" bol deta hai; jawaab likhte-likhte screen par thode-thode words mein aata hai, sab ek saath ant mein nahi Chapter 22
structured output
fixed khaanon wala form. Model naam wale khaane bharta hai, jinka type pehle se tay hota hai, taaki program padh sake. Insaan ke liye paragraph nahi likhta Chapter 19
sub-agent
ek bade kaam ka ek hissa diya gaya helper, jo apne alag context mein kaam karta hai taaki main context chhota rahe Chapter 45
support log
madad ki har request ka ek chalta record, uski category aur jis account se aayi uske saath, jise har hafte product ke baare mein saboot ki tarah padha jaata hai Chapter 46
system card
AI system ka ek page ka label, dawai ki patti ke label jaisa: woh kis kaam ka hai, kaun sa data use karta hai, kaise test hua, kya galat karta hai aur use kis kaam mein nahi lena Chapter 29
system prompt
dukaan ki deewar par lage niyam, jo har order se pehle padhe jaate hain; app inhe har request ke saath bhejta hai, jisme likha hota hai ki assistant kaun hai aur use kya karna hai aur kya nahi Chapter 11
system-design interview
ek baatcheet jisme aapse ek AI feature bolkar design karne ko kaha jaata hai, aur judge approach, evaluation, failure, cost aur rollout par aapki soch se kiya jaata hai, code se nahi Chapter 47

T

take-home
employer ka diya hua kaam jo time limit ke andar akele karna hota hai, aur jo parakhta hai ki jab koi nahi dekh raha, tab aap kaise kaam karte hain Chapter 47
TAM
total addressable market: jaise poore shehar ki woh saari dukaanein jinhe kabhi bhi aapka product chahiye, aapke daam par; woh sab log jinhe problem hai Chapter 4
task type
5 tarah ke kaamon mein se kaun sa kaam ek request asal mein hai: classify, extract, summarise, rewrite ya generate Chapter 12
temperature
ek dial jo tay karta hai ki model agle shabd mein kitna jokhim uthaata hai; low rakhne par safe khelta hai aur har baar milte-julte jawaab deta hai, high rakhne par chance leta hai aur zyada variety deta hai Chapter 11
test set
teacher ka question paper, jisme sahi jawaab pehle se likhe hon: asli ya asli jaise examples jinse system ko naapa jaata hai Chapter 12
time-box
unsure kaam ko diya gaya tay time, jiske ant mein decision hota hai Chapter 7
time-to-value
ek naye user ko activation moment tak pahunchne mein kitna time lagta hai, sign-up se naapa hua Chapter 43
token
text ki ek Lego eent: text ka ek tukda, aksar poora shabd aur kabhi shabd ka ek hissa; model eent-eent karke padhta hai, aur providers eent ke hisaab se paisa lete hain Chapter 8
token budget
text ki eenton ke liye kharche ka budget. Ek plan jo request ke har hisse ko tokens ka uska hissa deta hai, aur ek insaan jo total ka owner hai aur jaanta hai ki pehle kya kaatna hai Chapter 21
tool calling
model dukaandaar se kehta hai ki stock dekh do. Model ek function ka naam aur use kya dena hai, yeh batata hai. Aapka program use chalata hai aur result wapas bhejta hai Chapter 20
tool contract
machine par chhape niyamon jaisa: ek function, jo model bula sakta hai, uska theek-theek likha hua agreement, jisme uska naam, woh kya karta hai aur kya nahi, parameters, errors, side effects, aur use kaun bula sakta hai likha hota hai Chapter 36
tool description
dukaan ki shelf par laga label. Kuch lines jo model ko batati hain ki function kya karta hai, kya wapas deta hai aur kya nahi. Model label padhkar chunta hai, isliye dhundhla label ek bug hai Chapter 20
toolchain
tools ka woh set jo ek team product banane aur chalane ke liye use karti hai, jise slots ki tarah dekha jaata hai, har slot ke paas ek kaam Chapter 45
trace record
parcel ka scan log, bas ek request ke liye: input, versions, steps, timing, cost aur woh khatam kaise hui Chapter 38
tracking plan
woh shared register jisme har event, uski properties, woh kab fire hota hai aur uska owner likha ho; engineers isse banate hain aur analysts isse maante hain Chapter 44
transformer
woh design jis par lagbhag har modern language model bana hai; iska main hissa attention hai Chapter 8

U

usability
woh darwaza jo bina board padhe khul jaata hai. Kya log bina madad ke khud samajh sakte hain ki cheez kaise istemaal karni hai Chapter 2
usability test
ek asli insaan ko prototype se koi kaam karte hue dekhna, bina use madad diye Chapter 7
usage block
har jawaab ke saath aane wala bill: kitne tokens andar gaye aur kitne bahar aaye, jiske hisaab se aapse paisa liya jaata hai Chapter 9
usage pricing
taxi ke meter jaisa. Jitna use hua, har unit ka charge, jaise har message ya call, taaki aapki kamayi cost ke saath chale. Buyer bill ka andaaza nahi laga paata, aur paisa bachane ke liye kam use kar sakta hai Chapter 42
user interview
gawah ka bayaan, vote nahi. Aisi baatcheet jo yeh jaanne ke liye hoti hai ki ek insaan ne asal mein kya kiya aur use kya chahiye tha, yeh nahi ki use aapka idea pasand aayega Chapter 3
user story
value ka ek tukda, user ki taraf se bataya gaya: woh kaun hain, kya chahte hain, aur kyun Chapter 7

V

validation
jawaab aane ke baad doosri jaanch, jaise clerk aapka bhara form jaanchta hai. Kya har khaana bhara hai? Kya har quote kiya phrase message mein sach mein hai? Chapter 19
value proposition
jaise dukaan ke bahar ka board; ek saaf statement ki aap kise serve karte hain, unke liye kaun sa kaam karte hain, aur unke paas jo hai usse behtar kyun hain Chapter 5
verifier
ek check, jaise ek test, jo agent ko batata hai ki uska apna badlaav kaam kiya ya nahi, bina is ke ki koi insaan har line padhe Chapter 45
vertical slice
ek patli cycle jo pehle din se chalti hai: ek chalta hua patla version jo system ki har layer se guzarta hai, taaki asli user use jaldi aazma sake Chapter 7
viability
kya dukaan kharche se zyada kamati hai. Kya product business ke liye chalta hai: uski kamaai, uska cost, kanoon, aur uski saakh Chapter 2
virality
users ka doosre users ko laana Chapter 43
voice pipeline
kai daudne walon ki relay race jaisa: alag-alag stages ki chain jisse voice system guzarta hai, awaaz pakadne se lekar us par action lene tak; har stage delay jodta hai aur har ek matlab badal sakta hai Chapter 37

W

wedge
jaise lakdi ke tukde mein sabse pehle ghusne wali patli nok; woh chhota pehla use jise aap saaf-saaf jeet sakte hain, aur jo kisi badi cheez ka raasta kholta hai Chapter 5
weights
model ke andar ke dials: arabon numbers jinmein woh sab kuch hai jo usne seekha; training unhe ghumati hai, aam use nahi Chapter 8
worked example
aap jaisa output chahte hain, uska ek poora bana hua sample, jo model ko dikhaya jaata hai, taaki woh aapke description se andaaza lagane ki jagah format copy kare Chapter 11
